:::{#def-lrt-stat}
#### Likelihood ratio statistic

Suppose a null hypothesis $H_0$ imposes $q$ constraints on the parameter vector $\vth$.
Let $\hthml$ be the unrestricted MLE
and $\hat\th_0$ the MLE under $H_0$.
The **likelihood ratio statistic** is

$$
\Lambda \eqdef 2\paren{\llik(\hthml) - \llik(\hat\th_0)}
$$

:::
